question: A $1\text{ m}$ long wire of area of cross-section $2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ m}^2$ has resistance $0.01\Omega$. From its resistivity, identify whether it is likely to be a metallic conductor or an insulator.

options.A: $\rho=2\times10^{-4}\,\Omega\text{ m}$; it is likely an insulator
options.B: $\rho=2\times10^{-6}\,\Omega\text{ m}$; it is likely an insulator
options.C: $\rho=2\times10^{-8}\,\Omega\text{ m}$; it is likely a metallic conductor
options.D: $\rho=2\times10^{8}\,\Omega\text{ m}$; it is likely a metallic conductor
